title: Lore Server
author: Epic Games
tagline: Version control for very large binary assets

LORE_GRPC_PORT.title: Lore gRPC (TCP)
LORE_GRPC_PORT.description: gRPC over TCP for Lore clients: push, clone, admin and repository operations. Keep this on the same number as the QUIC port below, because a client is configured with one endpoint address for both transports.

LORE_QUIC_PORT.title: Lore QUIC (UDP)
LORE_QUIC_PORT.description: QUIC over UDP for Lore clients: the high-performance data plane. Keep this on the same number as the gRPC port above.
